svg.title: WITHDRAWN: Proflame direct ESP32 wiring
svg.desc: Owner measured plus 6.26 volts DC white to yellow with OEM dongle connected. Previous 3.3 volt label is wrong for this unit. Do not connect any X0A wires to ESP32. Signal levels and isolation are unresolved.

g.text: DIRECT WIRING WITHDRAWN — DO NOT CONNECT
The previous 3.3 V supply label does not apply to this measured unit.
Owner measurement: +6.26 V DC, white relative to yellow
Red probe white, black probe yellow; OEM Proflame Connect dongle plugged in.
WHITE: measured supply. Not safe for direct ESP 3V3/GPIO connection.
GREEN / BROWN: signal levels, direction and interface type not verified.
Keep all four X0A wires disconnected from the C5.
Use the OEM dongle. Keep the C5 separately USB-powered and disconnected.
A buck converter only addresses power—not signal levels or isolation.
Do not press Check IFC Link on an unverified electrical connection.
Updated 2026-11-06. See electrical-findings.md for source evidence and remaining limits.
